messages:
ana: Heads-up  were planning tiered credit experiment TC-JUN-26 (0%, 5%, 10% credits by cohort). Need final sign-off on ledger handling, tax treatment, and partner rev-share mapping.

jess: From billing ops: ledger flow should create a non-revenue 'promo_credit' line item with metadata: {price_version, cohort, promo_pct, approval_id}. Credits to be applied on next invoice; do not alter historical invoices.

nate: Implementation detail: we must cap credits to invoice amount to avoid negative invoices for prepaid annuals. Any remainder becomes account balance. This keeps gateway refunds minimal.

rebecca: Partnerships question: for Marketplace/reseller SKUs that have partner commissions, do we apply promo credits before or after partner revenue share calc? That changes partner payouts.

mike: Product preference: apply promo credits after calculating partner commission (i.e., credit reduces our net, not partner gross), because marketplace partners expect payouts based on gross list price. But that may hurt our margin. Open to debate.

emily: Tax check from finance: credits may be taxable in some jurisdictions if they reduce consideration. tax-bot, any guidance?

tax-bot: For most jurisdictions, credits that are customer-facing discounts reduce taxable revenue; however, treatment varies. Recommend tagging credits with tax_code="promo" and include in monthly tax export for review by tax team. Provide jurisdiction list for high-risk countries.

jess: ok we'll add tax_code field and include promo lines in tax export. Nate + Jess will draft edge-case rules for prepaid and negative balances.

sandeep: Engineering notes: need header X-Redwood-Price-Version and request attribute rw.cohort=tc-jun-26-opt5/etc. Also add webhook event billing.promo_applied with payload: invoice_id, account_id, promo_pct, credit_amount, tax_code. Sample payload below:
```
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_123",
  "account_id": "acct_456",
  "promo_pct": "5",
  "credit_amount": "12.34",
  "tax_code": "promo"
}
```
Estimate 2 engineer-days for API + webhook + export.

mike: analytics: we need cohort-level realized ARPU and net MRR impact. Include partner_payout_amount and taxable_revenue in the daily export.

rebecca: partnerships will require an exceptions spreadsheet for accounts where partner contracts forbid retro discounts. We'll flag those and exclude them from the experiment. Partner-ops to deliver list by Thu EOD.

jess: support: prepare macros for "What is this credit" and "Why did my partner payout not change". Also prepare a reconciliation CSV that lists credit rows and approval_id for audit.

nate: approvals: create a short approval flow. Manual approvals for credits > $5k per account. We'll store approval_id and approver in ledger tag.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing calendar lock 2026-06-25 22:00 UTC. Any promo metadata after lock will apply next cycle.

ana: Action items: 1) ledger + tax tagging + approval rules (jess + nate)  Wed EOD. 2) partnership exclusion list (rebecca)  Thu EOD. 3) eng header + webhook + export (sandeep)  PR by Mon. 4) analytics export fields (mike)  Mon EOD. 5) support macros + reconciliation CSV template (jess). 6) tax team to review jurisdiction list (emily).

jess: i'll draft the ledger spec and post in #finance-docs. keeping credits as non-revenue lines simplifies audits.

sandeep: will prioritize webhook and include tax_code. will aim for daily export schema in the PR.

emily: looping tax review now. will post high-risk jurisdiction list by Tue.

ana: thanks everyone. prefer to delay launch by a week if partner exclusions or tax blockers remain unresolved. Escalate to me if needed. :thumbsup:
